checked.note: verified in a running system - human live check 2026-07-20 following the interaction checklist (all listed checks passed) **e2e-verified 2026-09-12** (interaction module meta/interactions/z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_025.mjs: senderPress round-trips PRESSED into 'Pressed on <author>', and the Delete entry of the bound actions sheet round-trips ACTION_PRESSED with the row index so the entry is DELETEd and 'Item deleted' toasts)

deviations.what: the original's removeItem derives the entry index from the item's binding-context path (getBindingContext().getPath().split('/').pop()); the port transports the List's indexOfItem(item) instead - the aggregation index equals the model index for this bound list, so the spliced row is the same.

feed.json entries 2 and 4 have no Actions property; the flat ABAP row type serializes ACTIONS as an empty array ([] instead of undefined) - the actions aggregation renders no actions either way, and an empty array is not an empty-string/enum hazard.
the relative AuthorPicUrl asset paths (test-resources/sap/m/images/*.jpg) are rewritten to absolute https://sdk.openui5.org/test-resources/... per the project rule for runtime asset URLs.

sap.m.FeedListItem.actions is carried 1:1 from the original - the sample's whole point is the action sheet on a feed item. The aggregation PREDATES 1.71: at tag 1.71.0 sap.m.FeedListItem declares `actions: {type: 'sap.m.FeedListItemAction', multiple: true}` itself, and it is even that control's defaultAggregation there (sap.m.FeedListItemAction is @since 1.52.0). What changed is that the aggregation was GENERALISED and relocated to sap.m.ListItemBase, whose JSDoc carries @since 1.137 - and that is the version any scanner reads, so the property gate reports it. The relocated-member residual limit AGENTS section 5 names, the same shape as apps 241/299/300/301/302/407. Declared by policy so the gate has something to match. IMPORTANT, because the first version of this entry (2026-08-21, a few hours earlier) said the opposite and was wrong: the app does NOT need UI5 >= 1.137, it runs on the 1.71 floor. The class nevertheless sits in src/02/01, because AGENTS section 3 derives the package mechanically from 'has a POST_171' - this is the corpus' first port whose ONLY POST_171 is a scanner artefact rather than a real runtime floor, so the folder here records the declaration, not a requirement.
